title: 6 Day Samburu and Masai Mara Fly-in Safari
rank_math_title: Samburu Fly-in Safari: 6 Wonderful Days with the Mara
rank_math_desc: Samburu fly-in safari for 6 days: rare northern wildlife in Samburu, then big cats in the Masai Mara, linked by light-aircraft flights. Price on request.
post_content: This Samburu fly-in safari pairs the dry, rugged north with the open plains of the Masai Mara, using flights to cover the long distances.
overview:
This Samburu fly-in safari shows you two very different sides of Kenya. Samburu, in the dry north, is home to animals you will not see in the south, while the Masai Mara is famous for big cats and the migration.

The two reserves are far apart by road, so flying makes this route easy and comfortable.

Why choose this Samburu fly-in safari?

  • Samburu Special Five: reticulated giraffe, Grevy's zebra, Beisa oryx, gerenuk and Somali ostrich.
  • The Ewaso Ng'iro River: elephants, leopards and crocodiles along the banks.
  • Masai Mara: lions, cheetahs and huge herds on the plains.
  • Time saved: flights replace two full days of driving.

Where you stay

Two nights at Ashnil Samburu Camp and three nights at Mara Serena Safari Lodge, or similar.

Best time for a Samburu fly-in safari

Samburu is dry for most of the year and good in every season. July to October adds the migration in the Mara.

Prefer the road? See our Kenya safaris. Browse all flight packages, or read about the region on the Kenya Wildlife Service website.

How much does the Samburu fly-in safari cost?

Price on request. The cost depends on your travel dates, group size, the season and the lodges you choose, so we prepare every quote personally rather than showing one fixed price.

WhatsApp us on +254 706 223888, email bookings@divulgeadventures.com or send the enquiry form on this page, and we will share a detailed quote for your dates.

faq.q: How do I fly from Samburu to the Masai Mara?
faq.a: By scheduled light aircraft, usually with a stop or connection on the way. Your flights are booked and confirmed by us.

faq.q: How much luggage can I bring?
faq.a: Light aircraft usually allow 15 kg per person, including hand luggage, in soft bags without wheels. Ask us if you need extra space.

faq.q: What are the Samburu Special Five?
faq.a: Reticulated giraffe, Grevy's zebra, Beisa oryx, gerenuk and Somali ostrich, all adapted to the dry north.

faq.q: Which lodges are used on the Samburu fly-in safari?
faq.a: Ashnil Samburu Camp and Mara Serena Safari Lodge, or similar.
Yes, days are warm to hot, often over 30 °C. Mornings and evenings are pleasant.

faq.q: Is this safari good for photographers?
faq.a: Very good. Samburu's red earth and the Mara's open plains give varied, beautiful backgrounds.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Fly from Nairobi to Samburu
itinerary.content: Morning flight from Wilson Airport to Samburu. Game drive on the way to Ashnil Samburu Camp and an afternoon drive along the river.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Full day in Samburu
itinerary.content: Morning and afternoon game drives in search of the Samburu Special Five, elephants and leopards.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Fly from Samburu to the Masai Mara
itinerary.content: Early game drive, then fly to the Masai Mara. Afternoon game drive and check-in at Mara Serena Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Masai Mara
itinerary.content: A full day of game drives with a picnic lunch on the plains.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Masai Mara
itinerary.content: Another full day in the reserve. An optional sunrise balloon flight can be added.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Fly back to Nairobi
itinerary.content: Morning game drive and a flight back to Wilson Airport.
